meta.name: proxies
meta.description: Oxylabs proxy networks: Residential, Mobile, shared Datacenter/ISP, and Dedicated Datacenter/ISP proxies with geo-targeting, IP rotation, session persistence, and port-based sticky IPs. Use when routing traffic through proxies, building scrapers with proxy auth, rotating or sticky sessions, whitelisting IPs, or accessing geo-restricted content.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代理管理 IP 和会话,让爬虫抓取受限内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你做爬虫或数据采集,需要轮换代理 IP 并保持会话。
copy.tagline_en: Manage proxy IPs and sessions for scraping geo-restricted content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build scrapers or collect data and need rotating or sticky proxy sessions.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你配置 Oxylabs 代理(住宅、移动、数据中心、ISP 等),生成带认证、地区定向、IP 轮换或固定会话的 curl 命令。
howto.when: 当你要求通过代理访问网页、搭建带代理认证的采集器或访问地区限制内容等场景时触发。

say.text: 用数据中心代理轮换 IP 抓取这个页面,端口用 8000。
固定会话 5 分钟,会话 ID 用 mysession123。
say.note: 会在用户名加 sessid 和 sesstime 参数。

howto.what_en: Claude can configure Oxylabs proxy networks (residential, mobile, datacenter, ISP, dedicated) and generate curl commands with authentication, geo-targeting, IP rotation, and sticky sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to route traffic through a proxy, build a scraper with proxy auth, or access geo-restricted content.

say_en.text: Use a residential proxy to access https://ip.oxylabs.io/location with country US.
say_en.note: Generates curl with customer- auth and cc-US.

say_en.text: Fetch this page via datacenter proxy with rotation on port 8000.
Keep the same IP for a 5-minute session with ID mysession123.
say_en.note: Adds sessid and sesstime to username.
